items.title: What is a dynamic residential proxy?
items.description: A dynamic residential proxy is a high-anonymity Proxy proxy service based on real residential Proxy, supporting automatic Proxy rotation. With dynamic residential proxies, users can bypass website restrictions and improve the success rate of data collection and web scraping. They are widely used for large-scale data collection, anonymous browsing, ad verification, and more.

items.title: What rotation strategies are available for dynamic residential proxies?
items.description: IPFlex dynamic residential proxies support multiple Proxy rotation strategies, including automatic rotation at set time intervals, session-based rotation, and smart rotation (which automatically adjusts based on the target website's anti-crawling mechanisms). Users can flexibly configure these options to improve stability and anonymity.

items.title: What's the difference between dynamic and static residential proxies?
items.description: Dynamic residential proxies automatically rotate residential Proxy and are suitable for scenarios requiring high anonymity and large-scale access. Static residential proxies provide fixed residential Proxy, ideal for use cases that need long-term Proxy stability. The choice depends on your specific needs.

items.title: How do I set the Proxy rotation frequency?
items.description: You can customize the rotation frequency for residential proxies, including time-based intervals (1–30 minutes), session-based rotation, or enabling smart rotation mode. Flexible rotation settings help improve the success rate of data collection and web scraping.

items.title: How reliable and stable are dynamic residential proxies?
items.description: IPFlex dynamic residential proxies use intelligent health checks to monitor Proxy quality in real time and automatically remove problematic Proxy. The average success rate is up to 99.9%. High-quality residential Proxy resources ensure stable and efficient data collection and anonymous access.

items.title: Which protocols and authentication methods are supported?
items.description: IPFlex dynamic residential proxies support HTTP and SOCKS5 protocols, compatible with mainstream proxy software and crawler tools. Authentication methods include username/password and Proxy whitelist, and an API is provided for easy integration into your applications.
